response.original_title: Sally Ann Hall: Dead Wife Pretty
response.overview: Performing in front of a Lower East Side crowd in her adopted hometown of New York, Sally Ann Hall delights with stories of growing up in Alaska in this debut special. Mixing the presence of a trained actor with the quick wit and sarcasm of a seasoned comedian, Sally Ann shares her hilarious insights on working in the service industry, marriage, and life in the theater.
response.tagline: Glamourous high-school drop-out Sally Ann presents a traditional standup show that butts heads with traditional values.
response.title: Sally Ann Hall: Dead Wife Pretty
